project: Klaro Medical AI Platform - Production Hardening

stack_adjustment.note: OpenAI/Anthropic removed per authorization; EPIC-01/02 tasks updated accordingly

architectural_goals: Gemini-exclusive AI architecture (gemini-3.6-flash via GEMINI_API_KEY) with streaming SSE and model-version fallback
Production-grade RAG system with 6 specialized medical chunking strategies and <200ms vector search via Supabase pgvector
Prompt caching infrastructure with memory/Redis backends reducing API costs by ~40%
Hardened file upload and OCR pipeline for complex medical PDFs with hallucination validation
HIPAA-style ephemeral chat handling with PHI scrubbing, AES-256-GCM and audit logging
Offline-capable PWA with E2E encrypted local storage and edge-optimized latency
Flagship UI/UX foundations for /scan with SSE sidecar, drag-drop, camera and multi-format viewers
